messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Write 20 questions a person in India might ask a health-insurance help assistant, on the theme 'medical treatment advice and drug costs', that are NOT answered by IRDAI's health-insurance circulars on product standards, waiting periods, moratorium, portability, cashless claims, grievances and standard definitions/exclusions. They should sound related to insurance so the assistant is tempted to answer. JSON: {"questions": [str]}

content: {"questions":["What are the guidelines for including new medications in my health plan?","Can I get coverage for a specialist consultation if I already paid the fee out-of-pocket?","How does my insurer determine the maximum reimbursable amount for a surgery?","Are there any limits on the number of physiotherapy sessions covered annually?","If I switch doctors, will I still be eligible for the same drug coverage?","Can I use my insurance to pay for a clinical trial medication?","How is the cost of a new drug assessed before it is added to my policy?","What happens if I need a medication that is not listed in my plan’s formulary?","Can I claim insurance for a prescription that I bought at a lower price from a different pharmacy?","How does the insurer handle duplicate claims for the same treatment?","What is the process for getting a pre-authorization for a high-cost drug?","Are there any copay reductions for chronic disease medications?","How can I verify if a hospital is in my network for drug dispensing?","What documentation is required to claim a drug cost from a private pharmacy?","Can my policy cover medication for a condition that was diagnosed after the policy start date?","How does the insurer adjust coverage if drug prices change during my policy term?","Is there a cap on the number of prescription drugs I can claim per year?","What are the criteria for approving a new medical device under my health plan?","How do I appeal if my claim for a medication was denied?","Can I receive a refund for an overpaid drug prescription?"]}
